description: Source code for handling and fixing imagetags in firmware images, including CRC calculations, validation, and modification of image headers.

methods.name: strntoul
methods.description: Converts a string segment to an unsigned 32-bit integer with specified length and base.

methods.name: compute_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified file region.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes or updates the imagetag header CRCs and related fields in a firmware image.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Validates the imagetag header CRC and checks if the image fits in the specified MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the imagetag header CRC in a specified MTD device at a given offset.
